name: info-card
title: Info Card
description: A reusable section for displaying labeled detail items. Layout is controlled via className (flexbox, grid, etc.).

migration.guide: Info Card v2 removes the layout, columns, and fullWidth props. Use className on Root for layout (e.g. className="flex-row flex-wrap items-stretch" for inline, className="grid grid-cols-2" for grid). Use className="w-full" on Item instead of the fullWidth prop. Action no longer auto-squares — use className="size-[70px]" for the square action pattern.

docs.lead: Display labeled key-value detail items within a section card. Layout is fully controlled via className — use flexbox for inline, CSS grid for columns, or the default stacked flex-col.
docs.usage:
import * as InfoCard from "@/components/ui/info-card"

<InfoCard.Root className="flex-row flex-wrap items-stretch">
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Label</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>Value content</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
</InfoCard.Root>

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Items displayed side by side using flex-row. Uses Avatar for the user image.
examples.code: Submitted date Jan 3, 2025 Created by Sean Muir

examples.title: Inline with Full Width Item
examples.description: Mix inline and full-width items using className="w-full" on the item.
examples.code:
<InfoCard.Root className="flex-row flex-wrap items-stretch">
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Submitted date</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>...</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Created by</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>...</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
  <InfoCard.Item className="w-full">
    <InfoCard.Label>Publication status</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>
      <StatusBadge.Root status="pending">
        <StatusBadge.Icon as={RiAlertFill} />
        Require changes
      </StatusBadge.Root>
    </InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
</InfoCard.Root>

examples.title: Grid (2 Columns)

examples.title: With Action
examples.description: Inline layout with a square action button. Uses size-[70px] for a 1:1 box; sibling items stretch to match its height.
examples.code:
<InfoCard.Root className="flex-row flex-wrap items-stretch">
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Submitted date</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>...</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
  <InfoCard.Item>
    <InfoCard.Label>Created by</InfoCard.Label>
    <InfoCard.Value>...</InfoCard.Value>
  </InfoCard.Item>
  <InfoCard.Action className="size-[70px]" />
</InfoCard.Root>

api.name: InfoCard.Root
api.description: The container for info card items. Default layout is flex-col. Use className for inline (flex-row), grid, or other layouts.

api.name: InfoCard.Item
api.description: An individual card containing a label and value.

api.name: InfoCard.Label
api.description: The label text for an info card item.

api.name: InfoCard.Value
api.description: The value container for custom-rendered content. Defaults to text-label-xs and text-text-sub-600 styling.

api.name: InfoCard.Action
api.description: An action button styled like an info card item. Renders a default RiArrowRightUpLine icon that can be overridden via children. Renders as an anchor tag when href is provided, otherwise a button. Use className="size-[70px]" for the square action pattern.

props.name: href
props.description: When provided, renders as an anchor tag instead of a button.

props.name: notification
props.description: Show a notification dot in the top-right corner.
